fact: The African Development Bank notice says Tunisia intends to use loan funds for a contract to set up an e-Justice services portal and a business application for the Ministry of Justice.
system: Portail de Services E-Justice et Application Métier

fact: The Minister of Justice authorised on 25 May 2023 the pilot of the Jshare platform for electronic exchange of civil court documents in a number of model courts, with training of judges, lawyers and clerks to start.

La Presse, citing an Administrative Tribunal communique, reports the tribunal's central first-instance chambers held their first hearings on the Selim e-justice system, which is stated generalised to all chambers and all phases of procedure after regional chambers were digitised.

News Tunisia reports the Provisional Supreme Council of the Judiciary's first vice-president said on 29 October 2026 that the programme to digitise the Administrative Court's services had begun in part.
